## setting up function
```{r}

run_moderation <- function(data, moderator) {

  pvs <- paste0("PV", 1:10, "SCIE")
  weights <- c("W_FSTUWT", paste0("W_FSTURWT", 1:80))

  # Check that the required columns exist
  needed <- c("ESCS", moderator, "CNT", "MALE", pvs, weights)
  missing_columns <- setdiff(needed, names(data))

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  d <- data |>
    drop_na(all_of(needed)) |>
    filter(W_FSTUWT > 0) |>
    mutate(CNT = factor(CNT))

  d$ESCS_ICT <- d$ESCS * d[[moderator]]

  controls <- c("CNT", "MALE")

  baseline <- pisa.reg.pv(
    pvlabel = pvs,
    x = c("ESCS", controls),
    data = d,
    std = FALSE
  )

  additive <- pisa.reg.pv(
    pvlabel = pvs,
    x = c("ESCS", moderator, controls),
    data = d,
    std = FALSE
  )

  interaction <- pisa.reg.pv(
    pvlabel = pvs,
    x = c("ESCS", moderator, "ESCS_ICT", controls),
    data = d,
    std = FALSE
  )


  results <- list(
    moderator = moderator,
    n_students = nrow(d),
    country_counts = count(d, CNT, name = "n_students"),
    baseline = baseline,
    additive = additive,
    interaction = interaction
  )


  output_dir <- here::here("tables", "05_moderation_analysis")

  dir.create(
    output_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )


  baseline_table <- results$baseline$reg |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term")

  additive_table <- results$additive$reg |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term")

  interaction_table <- results$interaction$reg |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term")

  readr::write_csv(
    baseline_table,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0("baseline_", tolower(moderator), ".csv")
    )
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    additive_table,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0("additive_", tolower(moderator), ".csv")
    )
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    interaction_table,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0("interaction_", tolower(moderator), ".csv")
    )
  )

  return(results)
}


```

# Interaction plots

```{r}
#| label: fig-moderation-interactions
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-cap: "Interactions between ESCS and four ICT measures in predicting science performance."
#| warning: false
#| message: false

moderator_info <- tibble::tribble(
  ~moderator,  ~panel_title,                    ~axis_label,
  "ICTSCH",    "1. ICT availability at school",   "ICT availability at school",
  "ICTQUAL",   "2. Quality of access to ICT",     "Quality of access to ICT",
  "ICTWKEND",  "3. Frequency of ICT activity – Weekend", "Frequency of ICT activity – Weekend",
  "AIUSESCH",  "4. Students' AI use at school",   "Students' AI use at school"
)

# This works both when the QMD is run from R/ and from the project root.
model_dir <- file.path("tables", "05_moderation_analysis")
if (!file.exists(file.path(model_dir, "interaction_ictsch.csv"))) {
  model_dir <- file.path("R", "tables", "05_moderation_analysis")
}

read_interaction_coefs <- function(moderator) {
  path <- file.path(
    model_dir,
    paste0("interaction_", tolower(moderator), ".csv")
  )

  coefs <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # The existing AIUSESCH file was written without its row-name column.
  # Its rows have the same term order as the other interaction tables.
  if (!"term" %in% names(coefs)) {
    template <- readr::read_csv(
      file.path(model_dir, "interaction_ictsch.csv"),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )

    if (nrow(coefs) != nrow(template)) {
      stop("Cannot recover coefficient names for ", basename(path))
    }

    recovered_terms <- template$term
    recovered_terms[recovered_terms == "ICTSCH"] <- moderator
    coefs <- dplyr::bind_cols(term = recovered_terms, coefs)
  }

  coefs |>
    dplyr::select(term, Estimate)
}

weighted_quantile <- function(x, w, probs = c(0.25, 0.75)) {
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  x <- x[keep]
  w <- w[keep]
  ord <- order(x)
  x <- x[ord]
  cumulative_weight <- cumsum(w[ord]) / sum(w)

  vapply(
    probs,
    function(p) x[which(cumulative_weight >= p)[1]],
    numeric(1)
  )
}

make_interaction_data <- function(moderator, panel_title, axis_label) {
  coefs <- read_interaction_coefs(moderator)
  b <- stats::setNames(coefs$Estimate, coefs$term)

  # Match the complete-case sample used by run_moderation().
  pvs <- paste0("PV", 1:10, "SCIE")
  replicate_weights <- paste0("W_FSTURWT", 1:80)
  needed <- c(
    "ESCS", moderator, "CNT", "MALE", "W_FSTUWT",
    pvs, replicate_weights
  )

  d <- pisa_analytics |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(needed)) |>
    tidyr::drop_na() |>
    dplyr::filter(W_FSTUWT > 0)

  # Average the fitted country and gender controls over the model sample.
  country_terms <- paste0("CNT", as.character(d$CNT))
  country_effect <- unname(b[country_terms])
  country_effect[is.na(country_effect)] <- 0

  control_offset <-
    b["(Intercept)"] +
    b["MALE"] * stats::weighted.mean(d$MALE, d$W_FSTUWT) +
    stats::weighted.mean(country_effect, d$W_FSTUWT)

  escs_values <- weighted_quantile(d$ESCS, d$W_FSTUWT)
  moderator_values <- weighted_quantile(d[[moderator]], d$W_FSTUWT)

  tidyr::expand_grid(
    ict_level = c("Low", "High"),
    ses_level = c("Low ESCS", "High ESCS")
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      ESCS = escs_values[match(ses_level, c("Low ESCS", "High ESCS"))],
      moderator_value = moderator_values[match(ict_level, c("Low", "High"))],
      predicted_science =
        control_offset +
        b["ESCS"] * ESCS +
        b[moderator] * moderator_value +
        b["ESCS_ICT"] * ESCS * moderator_value,
      panel_title = panel_title,
      x_label = paste(ict_level, axis_label),
      ses_level = factor(ses_level, levels = c("Low ESCS", "High ESCS")),
      x_label = factor(
        x_label,
        levels = paste(c("Low", "High"), axis_label)
      )
    )
}

interaction_plot_data <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  moderator_info,
  make_interaction_data
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    panel_title = factor(panel_title, levels = moderator_info$panel_title)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(panel_title, ses_level) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Express each line relative to its prediction at the low-ICT point.
    science_score_change =
      predicted_science - predicted_science[ict_level == "Low"]
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

moderation_interaction_plot <- ggplot(
  interaction_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = x_label,
    y = science_score_change,
    group = ses_level,
    linetype = ses_level,
    shape = ses_level
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    colour = "grey65",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(colour = "#222222", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(colour = "#222222", size = 2.4) +
  facet_wrap(
    vars(panel_title),
    ncol = 1,
    scales = "free_x",
    strip.position = "top"
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Low ESCS" = "solid", "High ESCS" = "22")
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Low ESCS" = 18, "High ESCS" = 15)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Change in predicted science performance\n(from low ICT)",
    linetype = NULL,
    shape = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.7),
    axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.7, "cm"),
    panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.8, "lines")
  ) +
  guides(
    linetype = guide_legend(order = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 1)
  )

moderation_interaction_plot

graph_dir <- if (dir.exists("../graphs")) "../graphs" else "graphs"
dir.create(graph_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(graph_dir, "moderation_interaction_plots.png"),
  plot = moderation_interaction_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```
